CHAPTER 3 · ITEM 03 / 08

Absolute and comparative advantage

Comparative advantage比較優勢

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify comparative advantage as the lower opportunity cost. Recognize that a producer can have absolute advantage in both goods and that trade can still create gains when opportunity costs differ.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

比較優勢看較低機會成本。即使一方兩種商品產能均較高，只要相對成本不同仍可互利交易；兩商品成本互為倒數，不能同時在兩者均有嚴格比較優勢。

Comparative advantage belongs to the lower opportunity-cost producer. Even a producer with absolute advantage in both goods can gain from trade with someone whose relative costs differ. With two goods, one producer cannot have a strictly lower relative cost in both.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A makes 10 X or 20 Y; B makes 6 X or 6 Y. X costs A 2 Y and B 1 Y, so B has comparative advantage in X. B 的 X 相對成本較低。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Who has comparative advantage in Y in this example? 誰在 Y 有比較優勢？
